source: Saudi retail package-unit prices (Homestyle: Zamil 5 TR + install/crane; Wsayaa: Midea 15 TR) cross-checked against Kuwaiti per-ton contract prices (Aljarida Mar 2022; Alsedra Nov 2024)
quote: مكيف باكيج الزامل 5 طن: 19,780.00 ر.س؛ تركيب + رافعة (+1,725.00 ر.س)
note: No 2024–26 Kuwaiti price for a rooftop package unit alone (unit+base+connections, no ducts) was found online, so KSA prices are used (SAR×0.0818) with 15% Saudi VAT removed (Kuwait has no VAT). Zamil 5 TR: (19,780+1,725)/1.15 = 18,700 SAR = 1,530 KWD = 306 KWD/TR supplied, craned and installed (a small unit, so it costs more per TR). Midea 15 TR package (wsayaa.com, 27,750 SAR incl. VAT, supply only) = 132 KWD/TR before installation. A Kuwaiti villa normally has 5–15 TR units, so the mid value is ~180 KWD/TR including base/curb, condensate, controls wiring and start-up. Kuwait check: whole ducted jobs are quoted per TR at 220 (Aljarida 2022) to 300 KWD (Alsedra 2024). Take away ductwork and grilles (~35–40%) and the unit share is ~150–190. Brands in Kuwait: Coolex (local, Alghanim Industries; the only AC maker in Kuwait), York, Carrier, Trane, Gree, Midea, Hitachi, SKM; older forum quotes put Trane ~20 KWD/TR above other brands. Spread 130 (large Chinese-brand unit) to 310 (small premium unit).

source: Kyum Trading (KSA) Midea concealed inverter ducted split 4 TR, supply price + installation allowance
quote: مكيف ميديا كونسيلد انفيرتر ( اسبلت دكت ) 4 طن — 8,534 ر.س — السعر توريد فقط
note: No Kuwaiti retail or contract price for a concealed ducted split was found. This uses a KSA price (SAR×0.0818, low confidence). 8,534 SAR is assumed to include 15% VAT: /1.15 = 7,421 SAR = 607 KWD = 152 KWD/TR supply only. Installation added from the KSA rate (Homestyle install + crane 1,725 SAR incl. VAT ≈ 123 KWD per 5 TR unit ≈ 25 KWD/TR), giving ~175 KWD/TR. This covers the indoor unit, outdoor unit, refrigerant piping and drain, but not ductwork, plenums or grilles. A search snippet put a Midea 56,000 BTU concealed unit at 14,650 SAR incl. VAT (≈223 KWD/TR supply), which sets the high end. Treat as a cross-check against hvac:packaged_tr; Kuwaiti villas mostly use rooftop package units, with ducted splits for single floors or annexes.

quote: Gree Split AC Economic 18,000 – 186.000 KD; Sharp Split AC 24,000 – 219.000 KD; Pipe kit length included with Wall unit are 5 M

source: Conserve Solution (Qatar, 2017) GCC AC system cost comparison
quote: VRF system QR 4500/TR; split/package system QR 2000/TR
note: No Kuwaiti or 2024–26 GCC per-TR VRF price was found. UAE 2026 guides give only lump sums (europeantechnical.ae: AED 40,000–150,000+ per villa by number of zones). Qatar 2017: QR 4,500/TR installed. Converted through the USD pegs (1 QAR ≈ 0.0843 KWD) this is ≈ 380 KWD/TR, about 2.25× split/package (QR 2,000/TR ≈ 169 KWD/TR, which matches Kuwait's ~220 KWD/TR all-in in 2022). Includes outdoor and indoor units, refrigerant piping, branch kits and controls, but not ductwork for ducted indoor units. The 2017 date and the Qatari source make this indicative only.

source: Jeddah AC contractor duct price page (2025): insulated galvanised duct per m²
quote: الدكت العازل: من 130 إلى 180 ريال سعودي للمتر المربع
note: No Kuwaiti per-m² or per-kg ductwork price was found (Kuwaiti fabricators such as Fawaz and Alghanim quote by project; Fawaz builds to SMACNA/DW144 in G90 galvanised sheet). KSA 2025: insulated galvanised duct 130–180 SAR/m² × 0.0818 = 10.6–14.7 KWD/m² (mid 12.7); uninsulated 90–130 SAR/m² = 7.4–10.6 KWD/m². The page does not say whether these include VAT or installation. Contractor 'per metre of duct' prices in KSA are usually fabricated and installed, so they are treated as supply+install. Per m² of sheet (duct surface), insulation wrap included. Flexible duct is extra: 40–70 SAR per running metre (3.3–5.7 KWD/m). Rough villa quantity: ~6–9 m² of sheet per TR.

source: Al Ramiz Equipment (UAE) supply diffuser prices + installation allowance
quote: Duct Diffuser (Supply): 12×12 inch AED 49.00; 15×15 inch AED 59.00; 18×18 inch AED 69.00
note: No Kuwaiti price list for diffusers was found. UAE supply prices × 0.0836: 12×12 in neck (fits a 600×600 face) 49 AED = 4.1 KWD; 15×15 = 4.9; 18×18 = 5.8. Added: plenum box, damper and ~1.5–2 m of insulated flex (HPG KSA: 7.5 m insulated flex 76 SAR ≈ 6.2 KWD per roll) ≈ 2–3 KWD, plus fixing labour ≈ 3 KWD, giving ~11 KWD each. Linear slot or designer diffusers per 1–1.2 m section run toward the 20 KWD high end. Kuwaiti per-TR contracts usually include grilles, so do not add both to benchmark:hvac_per_tr_installed.

source: Al Ramiz Equipment (UAE) return diffuser/grille prices + installation allowance
quote: Duct Diffuser (Return): 12×12 inch AED 19.00; 15×15 inch AED 39.00; 18×18 inch AED 59.00
note: UAE supply prices × 0.0836: 12×12 = 1.6 KWD, 15×15 = 3.3 KWD, 18×18 = 4.9 KWD. Usually included in Kuwaiti per-TR central AC contracts.

source: Kanbkam Kuwait (Honeywell T6861 price) + Gopeta Kuwait (smart Wi-Fi thermostat incl. installation)
note: Standard digital room thermostat (Honeywell T6861) 10.65 KWD in Kuwait, plus control cable and fixing ≈ 5 KWD ≈ 16 KWD. Package units often ship with a basic thermostat in the unit price. Smart Wi-Fi option: Gopeta Kuwait 'ثرموستات مكيف مركزي ذكي واي فاي' 49.990 KD 'شامل التركيب والبرمجة' (another model 35 KD on sale), which sets the high end. Typically one per zone/unit.

source: No separate rate found (included in Kuwaiti per-TR contracts)
quote: تصميم وتركيب وصيانة أفضل انظمة التكييف المركزي
note: No published Kuwaiti or GCC rate for testing, adjusting, balancing and commissioning of a villa unit was found. Kuwaiti central AC contractors (e.g. Fawaz: design, duct manufacture, installation, testing and commissioning) include start-up and commissioning in the per-TR contract price, and hvac:packaged_tr already includes start-up. If a separate line is needed, use ~2–3% of the HVAC subtotal as an assumption (not a sourced value). Related Kuwaiti retail charge: refrigerant gas charge 15 KD per unit (Forsa).

source: Forsa Kuwait AC installation policy (power point 1-phase/3-phase) + allowance for longer roof cable run
quote: Power Point (1 Phase and 3 Phase): 75.000 KD
note: A Kuwaiti retailer charges 75 KD for a new 1- or 3-phase AC power point (retrofit, split units). A rooftop package unit needs a weatherproof 3-phase isolator next to the unit plus a 4-core armoured cable (~10–16 mm²) of ~15–30 m from the villa DB up to the roof, plus an MCB/MCCB in the DB. The higher figure (~90; 150 for long runs or big units) is an estimate. Do not also count mep.json point:ac or circuit for the same unit.

source: Aljarida (Mar 2022) Kuwait central AC per ton; Alsedra Kuwait (Nov 2024) and Kuwaitpedia (Jan 2026) 300 KD/ton; Quds Co. Kuwait (Mar 2025) ducted 5–10 TR price band
quote: شركات التكييف المركزي أخطرت شركات المقاولات بنيتها رفع أسعارها … ليصل سعر الطن التكييف المركزي إلى 220 ديناراً
note: In Kuwait, central AC for private housing is contracted per ton of refrigeration for the whole job: units, ductwork, insulation, grilles, thermostats, installation and start-up. Aljarida (20 Mar 2022): contractors told prices would rise to 220 KD/TR. Alsedra (28 Nov 2024): 'يبلغ سعر طن التكييف المركزي الكويت 300 دينار كويتي'; Kuwaitpedia (Jan 2026) repeats 300. Quds Co. (Mar 2025): 'تكييف دكت مركزي | 5 - 10 طن | 1500 - 3500 د.ك' = 300–350 KD/TR. Older forum quotes (Indexsignal 2009–10): Coolex ~155, York ~175, Hitachi ~148 KD/TR. Value 280 (220 = 2022 floor, 350 = premium brand / small system). Cross-check: matrixkw1 budgets 18,000 KD for AC on a basement + 3.25-floor house, about 64 TR at 280. MOCI Decision 222/2024 gives a fixed 6,000 KD subsidy toward AC for a new house.

source: MEW/R-6/2014 Energy Conservation Code (Kuwait) villa A/C power-density limit; Alsedra Kuwait (Jul 2024) sizing formula; UAE comparison
quote: Table 5.1 Basic Energy Conservation Requirements of Different Standard Buildings (W/m²)
note: Sizing rule, not a price; basis is a placeholder. Kuwait MEW R-6 caps villa A/C peak electrical density (Table 5.1: ~70 W/m² for DX in the 2014 edition; later editions cite 55 W/m² for conventional A/C). At ~1.4–1.5 kW/TR for package units at Kuwaiti design conditions, this works out to ~20–26 m² of conditioned floor per TR. Contractor room-level rule (Alsedra Kuwait, Jul 2024): L×W×H×300/12,000 = TR, i.e. ~13 m²/TR for 3 m ceilings (conservative, per room). UAE villa rule (taskright.ae 2026): 1 TR per 35–45 m², lighter than Kuwait. Practice: about 1 TR per 18–22 m² of conditioned area, so a 250–280 m² villa floor takes ~12–15 TR, usually one or two rooftop package units per floor (e.g. 2 × 7.5 TR). Cross-check: matrixkw1 18,000 KD AC budget for a basement + 3.25-floor house (~1,250–1,350 m² BUA) at 280 KD/TR ≈ 64 TR ≈ 20 m²/TR.
